name: Dreamlands Cat
author: Sandy Petersen, James Jacobs, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher, and David N. Ross
heading: Dreamlands Cat Traits
version: Copyright 2018, ISBN 978-0-9995390-4-0. Author text consulted in a reproduction.
sourceDistinctions: Use the 1d3 days from Nine Lives in the actual trait block. The earlier lore text describes a 4d6-hour return for a mundane cat.
Terran, Martian, Saturnian, and Uranian are printed subraces. The original NPC uses Terran.

name: Mythos Ghoul
author: Sandy Petersen, James Jacobs, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher, and David N. Ross
heading: Ghoul Traits
version: Copyright 2018, ISBN 978-0-9995390-4-0. Author text consulted in a reproduction.
sourceDistinctions: The chapter heading reads Ghoul and uses Mythos ghoul to identify this living player option. It has a different creature type and traits from the undead Ghoul encounter record.
The original NPC uses Raised by Ghouls.

name: Gnorri
author: Sandy Petersen, James Jacobs, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher, and David N. Ross
heading: Gnorri Traits
version: Copyright 2018, ISBN 978-0-9995390-4-0. Author text consulted in a reproduction.
sourceDistinctions: Seln uses the Blue subrace, two arms, and Gnorri Science, with no Builder Magic. The Large creature handles a Medium spear.

name: Zoog
author: Sandy Petersen, James Jacobs, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher, and David N. Ross
heading: Zoog Traits
version: Copyright 2018, ISBN 978-0-9995390-4-0. Author text consulted in a reproduction.
sourceDistinctions: The printed player build is a Humanoid even though it moves on handlike paws. Only the printed player traits are used.
